note: Actual export shipments confirmed by dated Indian customs records with bill-of-lading numbers, all three consignments dated 2025-06-09 and 2025-09-09, all to Nepal (Birgunj and Biratnagar) via land ports Raxaul and Jogbani. Declared HS 293499 does NOT match any observed shipment line: observed codes are 29251100 (saccharin/sweetener 'SWEETLYTE 550X') and 44219990 (wooden ice-cream spoons/sticks). Per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground — company stays in the base, HS should be corrected to the factual codes (29251100 and 44219990) and verdict recorded as accepted_hs_corrected with this caveat. Note the 2025-06-09 rows share one BOL (2541229) across three line items, so 4 records = 3 distinct consignments. Role appears to be trader/exporter of third-party goods (sweetener from Lux Flavours/GSEC-type suppliers, wooden cutlery) rather than manufacturer of HS 293499 chemicals — role classification: trader (based on mixed, unrelated product lines and third-party branded goods). Domestic supply side: no traces of domestic deliveries found in public sources; this is a data gap, not a negative finding. ImportKey is a paid aggregator with a free preview; volza returned HTTP 403 and eximpedia/importgenius/trademo were not reachable within the call budget, so the 4-record figure is single-sourced and should be treated as a floor, not a total.
